title: Hello Console
short_description: Print a message to the console.
detailed_description:
The Prism's core is silent. Awaken it by printing 'Hello, Prism' to the console.

Use `console.log()` to output the message exactly.

tiered_hints_json.2: Ensure the string matches 'Hello, Prism' exactly (case-sensitive).

title: Variable Energy
detailed_description:
The Prism needs a stable energy source. 
1. Declare a variable named `energy` using `let`.
2. Assign it a value.
3. Print 'Energy: ' followed by the value.

tiered_hints_json.1: Use `let energy = 100;` to declare the variable.

title: Ignition Sequence
detailed_description: Initiate the ignition sequence. Create a loop that prints 'T-minus' at least once, followed by a final 'Liftoff!'.
starter_code:
// Write a loop for the countdown

console.log('Liftoff!');

objectives_json.title: Use a for or while loop

tiered_hints_json.1: A basic loop: `for (let i=10; i>0; i--) { ... }`

smoke.solution_code:
for(let i=3; i>0; i--) { console.log('T-minus ' + i); }
console.log('Liftoff!');
